name: Kyoudai☆Henshin Nau
source:
Suddenly, a strange plant appeared in the corner of the garden. That was the beginning of the incident.
The protagonist intended to throw it away, but his sister used it as an ingredient in miso soup, and when he ate it, strange things began to happen.
His consciousness was transferred to the family dog, then his sister, and he transformed into a cute girl.
At first, the protagonist panicked, but he decided to accept it, realizing that panicking wouldn't change anything.
He decided to take advantage of his position and have some fun, and enjoy himself to the fullest.

[Translated From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=840533]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
突然，花园的角落里出现了一株奇怪的植物。这就是事件的开始。
主角本打算扔掉它，但他的妹妹却将它用作味噌汤的配料，当他吃了它时，奇怪的事情开始发生。
他的意识转移到了家里的狗身上，然后转移到了妹妹身上，他变成了一个可爱的女孩。
起初，主角感到惊慌，但他决定接受它，因为他意识到惊慌并不能改变任何事情。
他决定利用自己的职位，好好享受一下。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=840533]Getchu[/url]]
